settings.title: Settings
settings.autosaveHint: Changes save automatically after you stop editing.
settings.languageHint: UI, reminders, and voice messages use this language.
settings.lead: Time zone, wake and sleep, reminders, Google Calendar, and account.
settings.timeManagementHint: These settings affect how your schedule is built. Wake, sleep, and phases use the time zone you set here.
settings.accountHint: You are signed in with Google. Signing out only ends this session; your data stays on this account.
settings.bufferHint: Free time before and after each fixed task and external Google event. Generate uses that gap only when the task would not fit otherwise. 0 turns it off. Dragging a block can still land in the gap.
settings.appCalendarNameHint: Events created by this app are written to a separate Google calendar with this title. Rename it here anytime; if Google is connected, the calendar title updates automatically.
settings.calendarNameSaveFailedDetail: Check your connection and try again.
settings.notLinkedHint: Calendar is linked automatically when you sign in with Google. Sign out and sign in again if this status does not update.

preset.flexibleHint: Planner picks a slot. You can still set a preferred start.
preset.fixedHint: Exact start and end; planner will not move it.
preset.recurringHint: Repeats on a pattern. Planner may move occurrences.
preset.unscheduledHint: A to-do with no calendar slot until you schedule it.

validation.endRequired: End time is required for fixed tasks

list.empty: No tasks found. Create one to get started.

habits.title: Habits
habits.lead: Check in any of the last 14 days. A daily time block, if you set one, stays free for that habit when you generate a schedule and is added to Google Calendar when it is connected.
habits.empty: No habits yet. Add one — for example Exercise or No smoking.
habits.deleteConfirm: Delete "{{name}}" and all of its check-ins? This cannot be undone.
habits.name: Name
habits.descriptionHint: Tap = a successful day. The name carries the meaning.
habits.reserveHint: Generate will not place tasks on top of this time. When Google Calendar is connected, the same block is added there every day.
habits.gridCaption: Habit check-ins for the last 14 days
habits.futureLocked: Future days cannot be checked in.
habits.rangeLocked: You can change check-ins for the last 14 days.

phases.title: Phases
phases.lead: Time windows for scheduling and the weekly template.
phases.presetLead: Replaces Sleep and every other phase. Times follow your wake and sleep settings. This is blocked while any phase still has tasks.
phases.selectWeekdaysDetail: Choose at least one day of the week for the preset.
phases.selectWeekdaysSetupDetail: Choose at least one day of the week for your phases.
phases.applyFailedDetail: Phases were not replaced. If a phase still has tasks, move or delete them first.
phases.updateFailedDetail: The new time was not saved. Try again.

phases.weekDaysRequired: Select at least one day of the week
phases.outsideActiveDay: Phase cannot be outside of active day time!
phases.presetWorkingDetail: Deep work, meetings, then life admin before sleep.
phases.presetStudentDetail: Classes, study, then free time before sleep.
phases.presetOpenDetail: Morning focus, errands, personal projects, and wind down.
phases.presetDefaultsDetail: The usual setup: sleep overnight and a hidden focus window.

phases.tapHint: Tap a phase to edit it. Times follow your wake and sleep window.
phases.setupLead: Wake and sleep times define the day. Pick weekdays, then a day shape.
phases.saveSettingsDetail: Wake and sleep times were not saved. Try again.

voice.listeningStop: Listening… tap Stop when you are done.

voice.confirmOffDetail: Those commands run as soon as they are understood.
voice.title: Voice
voice.sectionHint: Creating a task by voice still happens immediately. This switch only covers finishing, skipping, or moving a task.

reminders.hint: One reminder during the half hour before each timed block. A habit with a set time uses that clock. Habits without a time share one reminder before wake. Already checked habits stay quiet. On iPhone, add the app to the Home Screen first.
reminders.onDetail: This browser will get push notifications.
